recommendations: Anthea Guo “Ever since meeting Dylan, he has been an exceptional teammate and friend. From the get-go, he has shown endless motivation for our project. He was the person who kept the team going by planning meetings, keeping everyone up to pace, and most importantly, showing his own commitment to the project. His leadership is what pushed our team to win an international hackathon by designing an end-to-end app that helps the elderly navigate their phones. He is also exceptionally talented at coding full-stack phone-based apps and is efficient at debugging any problems that arise, and has a full suite of tools to scale his productivity. It was an honor working with Dylan, and I'm excited to see what he will accomplish next.”

Dr. Marney Randle “Dylan joined the Berkeley Student Leadership Academy (BSLA) Program as a participant and it was clear he was passionate about developing his own skills while improving the experience of his current and future peers. He noticed issues in the database to track workshops and participant progress and took the initiative to reach out to me (the Program Director) to communicate the issues, their impacts, and offer tangible solutions towards resolution. Dylan autonomously created a new comprehensive workshop tracker with improved accessibility and intuitive UI design that simplified processes and enhanced the user experience. He actively explored resources to learn Google sheet formulas, figure out how they work, and transfer it to fit our systems and needs. Upon request, Dylan created a user manual with clear instructions for both participant usage and tracker replication for the future. He also designed a system for reporting technical and data glitches and has actively addressed information in a timely manner. Throughout the course of this project, Dylan engaged in agile execution and iterative development processes with several stakeholders, including staff and students. Through Dylan’s creative design process, he streamlined automated data management and retrieval processes for 45 leadership workshops with 85 users that resulted in 300+ sources of data. Dylan’s kind demeanor and caring personality has been consistent throughout this project work. The positive energy that Dylan brings makes collaborating with him an enjoyable process. Dylan’s leadership and humility throughout this process has been exceptional; he has inspired others to take initiative and find ways they can help to enhance the BSLA program.I highly recommend Dylan for any opportunity that requires collaboration, improving automated systems, and enhancing product experiences.”

projects.title: Multi-Agent Specialization Pipeline
projects.description: MoE system that transforms general-purpose LLMs into reliable domain experts through collaborative multi-model consensus. Combined CrewAI structured workflows with CAMEL-AI reasoning and PEFT + RAG adaptation across GPT-4, Claude, Gemini, LLaMA, and Mixtral. Full audit trail infrastructure ensures regulatory compliance across all model outputs.

projects.title: Ping (HBSA x Anthropic Hackathon Finalist)
projects.description: Relationship intelligence that quietly learns who you've met across email, calendar, and LinkedIn, then surfaces the right person at the right moment so warm connections convert to referrals, collaborations, and opportunities.

projects.title: CITRIS Quest
projects.description: Cross-campus mobile scavenger hunt built from zero to deployment across 4 UC campuses, celebrating CITRIS' 25th anniversary. EfficientNetV2 classifier handles physical artwork recognition at 96% accuracy across 15,000+ scans, backed by GPS geofencing, SQLite LRU caching, and offline-capable gameplay for 1,000+ players.

projects.title: Assistify (Baidu Hackathon 2nd Place)
projects.description: Voice assistant for elderly smartphone users that delivers spatial audio guidance without overlays or visual UI – powered by ERNIE-4.5-VL multimodal screen understanding and Gemini embeddings for real-time context awareness. RAG-powered personalization via pgvector adapts vocabulary and pacing from conversation history. 92% task completion in beta.

projects.title: ANDROMEDA
projects.description: NLP-powered root cause analysis pipeline that cuts HPC job failure triage from 2+ hours to minutes on NASA's supercomputing systems. Trained a contrastive neural net on 2,000+ unlabeled job logs using Drain3 log parsing, clustering, semantic embeddings, and attention mapping to surface interpretable failure patterns at scale.
